deficits.evidence: footway is under 1m and partly blocked by obstructions
deficits.suggestion: Construct a continuous, usable sidewalk of at least 1m width along the left side of the road.

deficits.evidence: footway is partly blocked by parked vehicles or other obstructions
deficits.suggestion: Remove obstructions from the footway to ensure it is fully accessible for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: uneven sections on the footway that pose trip hazards
deficits.suggestion: Repair and level the footway to eliminate trip hazards for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: crossing demand is high due to mixed land use, but no crossing facility is present
deficits.suggestion: Install a signalised pedestrian crossing with a refuge island to accommodate crossing demand safely.

deficits.evidence: road has 4 or more lanes and no refuge on the crossing
deficits.suggestion: Add a refuge island in the middle of the crossing to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.
